name: io.github.Omodaka9375/netexpert-mcp
description: Cross-platform local-network diagnostics & security-posture MCP server — 31 tools.

environmentVariables.description: Path to the config JSON (default: ~/.netexpert-mcp/config.json). Zero-config: every key is optional. See the README for the schema.
environmentVariables.name: NETEXPERT_MCP_CONFIG

environmentVariables.description: If set (>0), also expose a stateless streamable HTTP transport at that port: POST /mcp (JSON-RPC) + GET /health. Loopback by default.
environmentVariables.name: NETEXPERT_HTTP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Linux only: the wlan interface for iw-based WiFi status (default wlan0).
environmentVariables.name: NETEXPERT_WIFI_IF
